Name: Harvey_Girl Dialogue change
Author: KeionDryke
Description:
Here's the dialogue change for Harvey to go along with Adarin's graphics change mod Harvey_Girl http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/448/?

[size=4][u]Installation

[/u][/size]unzip files into the Content folder in your Stardew Valley directory
let it over write any other files
Don't forget to back up  the originals

To Uninstall, just put the originals back and over ride the mod files

This mod is not compatible with other dialogue change mods but I will make an optional patch so it'll work with the other dialogue change mods I've done.

Please let me know if you find any errors.
Keep in mind certain things can't be changed yet like the door before 2 hearts and certain hard coded dialogue.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the mail you get from Harvey (Harriet)
